items.title: Kenny Burrell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We collaborated on a couple songs I think and I really enjoyed it. He did my Christmas album as well

ctx.x: really enjoyed it. He did my Christmas album as well which is a big seller, you know. So I enjoyed doing that.

Okay. Well, we can pick it up now. Yesterday when we closed out the first half of this interview we were looking at your career in the early-mid '60s. You had already started working in the pit orchestra with "Bye Bye Birdie," so all these other opportunities. The way I'd like to describe you is the three words I used to describe Eric Dolphy once when I was asked to write about Eric Dolphy was "virtuosity, versatility and voracity."
